games.name: Bloxrooms [Beta]
games.desc:
Endless rooms. Familiar places. Nothing is quite right.

Bloxrooms takes the games you think you remember and twists them into something that was never supposed to exist. Explore endless levels, uncover strange artifacts, and survive entities that don't follow the rules you thought you knew. The deeper you go, the more reality starts to fall apart. Every room feels familiar—but never exactly how you remember it.

🗺️ Explore Misremembered Levels
Discover corrupted areas inspired by games that feel strangely familiar.

👁️ Survive the Unknown
Watch for entities, study their behavior, and know when to run—or hide.

💎 Scavenge for Artifacts
Search each level for valuable artifacts and bring them back for cash.

🛠️ Upgrade Your Gear
Use your earnings to improve your equipment and push deeper into the rooms.
